# Paper-based case-study template

Every completed case study will record:

1. paper citation and biological claim;
2. raw-data accession, license, and checksum;
3. experimental unit and design diagram;
4. estimand;
5. original paper method;
6. analysis-ready data construction;
7. model formula and assumptions;
8. Python analysis;
9. selected R equivalent;
10. diagnostics and sensitivity analyses;
11. effect-size interpretation;
12. comparison with the published conclusion;
13. exercises and reproducibility session information.
